headline: Rising tariffs and energy costs drive up US import and holiday prices
summary: US import prices experienced their highest gain in four years, while holiday toy prices surged due to tariffs, energy costs, and Middle East conflicts.
why: Import prices serve as an early indicator of consumer inflation pressures, affecting profit margins for domestic retailers and purchasing power for households.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Higher wholesale import costs compress retail profit margins or reduce consumer demand.

why_moved: Supply chain disruptions and escalating trade tariffs increased the cost of goods entering the United States.
